description: This is a PHP source file implementing a controller class 'Cart' for the checkout process in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It contains methods for displaying the cart page, listing cart items, and adding items to the cart, involving session handling, product management, and URL routing.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: A controller class for managing the shopping cart in the checkout process, providing functionalities like viewing, listing, and adding cart items.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: A controller class for managing the shopping cart in the checkout process, providing functionalities like viewing, listing, adding, editing, and removing cart items.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main cart page, sets up breadcrumbs, checks stock and quantity errors, loads necessary models and views, and handles the case of empty cart with an error message.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the listing of cart items by calling getList() and outputting the result.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns an HTML view of the current cart contents, including products, totals, vouchers, and other cart details, formatted according to user login status and configuration.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart based on POST request data, including handling product options, quantity, subscription plans, and updating the cart session and response.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to update the quantity of a specific cart item, validating stock, handling product variants and options, and returning a JSON response indicating success or errors.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Processes the removal of a cart item identified by key, updating session and cart data, and returning a JSON response with success/error status.
